integration.content: Plain strings or explicit DOM Nodes; no HTML string evaluation
integration.data: `kind: info | success | warning | error`, `title`, `message: string | Node`, optional `action: {label, onClick}`, `dismissible`, `onDismiss`.
integration.api: `mount(element, options)` → `update(options)`, `destroy()`. `createToaster({document, container?, duration?})` → `show(options)` returning an id, `dismiss(id)`, `destroy()`. Duration defaults to 2400 ms; 0 keeps a toast until dismissed. Host owns when messages appear.
